raw_text: Massive farmer convoy mobilization underway across Punjab for Delhi march. Thousands of tractors assembling at multiple border points. Demand: legal guarantee for MSP. Social media being used extensively for real-time coordination including supply chains and barricade bypass strategies. This is the largest mobilization since the 2020-21 farm protests. #FarmersProtest2024 #MSP #DelhiMarch
clean_text: Massive farmer convoy mobilization across Punjab for Delhi march demanding legal MSP guarantee. Thousands of tractors at border points. Social media used for real-time coordination of supply chains and routes.
